title: A profile of Suno, which has been used by more than 100M people since 2023 and has 2M+ paid subscribers, as it faces copyright lawsuits from UMG and Sony Music (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: A profile of Suno, which has been used by more than 100M people since 2023 and has 2M+ paid subscribers, as it faces copyright lawsuits from UMG and Sony Music — Investors are betting the $5 billion company will be the next Spotify. — Mikey Shulman stands in the middle of a dark concert hall …
